import re

def slugify(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace multiple consecutive non-alphanumeric chars with one hyphen
    result = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    # Strip trailing punctuation (except apostrophes which we want to preserve)
    return result.rstrip("!?!;.:")

print(slugify("Hello World"))  # Should be hello-world
print(slugify("C++ rocks!"))   # Should be c-rocks
EOF

import re

# Common approach: replace non-alphanumeric with hyphen, preserve apostrophes
def slugify_v1(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    result = []
    for char in text:
        if char in "':-":  # Allow apostrophes and special chars
            result.append(char)
        else:
            result.append('-')
    return ''.join(result)

print(slugify_v1("Hello World"))  # hello-world
print(slugify_v1("C++ rocks!"))   # c--rocks- (preserves apostrophes)
